Deal [(SR+2)D + (Magic Power)] magical damage to the target.

(Fate 1): If you have reached your Limit for this skill, you may pay this cost to use it again.
(Fate 1): You may use this skill with [Target: Three].

An attack magic that converges the holy light emitted from the whole body and shoots it out in a beam to mow down the enemy. The brilliance of judgment will reduce many malice to ashes at your will.
